name: gpower-paired-clone
description: Paired t-test power analysis with CLI, MCP, and retained G*Power comparison evidence

scripts.test: tsx tests/differential.test.ts && tsx tests/gpower_gui.test.ts && tsx tests/mcp_equivalence.test.ts && tsx tests/cleanroom_equivalence.test.ts && npm run test:extended
scripts.test:extended: tsx tests/statsmodels.test.ts && tsx tests/manual.test.ts && tsx tests/expanded_gui.test.ts && tsx tests/cli_validation.test.ts && tsx tests/spec_only.test.ts
scripts.spec-only:build: tsc spec-only/engine.ts spec-only/cli.ts --target es2020 --module es2020 --strict --outDir spec-only/build --skipLibCheck
scripts.cleanroom:build: tsc cleanroom/t_paired.ts cleanroom/cli.ts --target es2020 --module es2020 --strict --outDir cleanroom/build --skipLibCheck
